author: Susan Gordon Byron, with Sam Illingworth
reported_outcomes: Byron reports questioning Lumo about sensory and mathematical transformations; no accessibility evaluation.
proposed_outcomes: Notice whether a tool respects a stated sensory association rather than correcting it as a factual error.
limits: The model has no demonstrated felt association; its explanation is generated language.
One response cannot diagnose a neurotypical system or represent all neurodiverse users.
Respecting a creative association differs from agreeing with a harmful factual belief.
review_note: Retain as an interaction and creative-expression exercise, not a test of consciousness or clinical accessibility.
coverage: Close-read all 176 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
